command_templates.name: parse_to_csv
command_templates.when: When you need to parse the Recent File Cache and output results in CSV format.

command_templates.name: parse_to_json
command_templates.when: When you need to parse the Recent File Cache and output results in JSON format.

usage_description: Parses the Windows Recent File Cache (BCF) registry hive to extract recently accessed file paths, which can be useful for identifying user activity or potential malware execution points.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Path to a known malicious executable
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates the presence of potentially malicious software.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Accessed time significantly different from system time
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate tampering or unusual activity.

known_false_positives: Legitimate system tools and executables may appear in the cache.
RecentFileCacheParser output can be influenced by user actions, such as browsing or running applications.
